notes.title: New Class “Engineer” Coming Early 2026!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,


It’s been about three months since the full release of Backpack Battles. During this time, we’ve mainly been rolling out balance updates while also working behind the scenes on the design of a brand-new class. Now, it’s finally time to reveal her!



We’re excited to officially introduce the seventh class coming to Backpack Battles – the Engineer! She’s currently in early development and is planned to release in early 2026. If you own the game, she will be available as a free update!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44182194/fee3ee5d293f66cfb673679a01a29b1c8c2e4cb2.png"]

A core mechanic of the Engineer will be shooting electrical charges, which provide bonuses as they travel over the items in her inventory. Some items can emit these charges, manipulate them, or benefit from them—like the Battery, which actively emits a charge.



In addition to electricity, the Engineer will also explore some secondary themes, such as stamina manipulation and advancing item cooldowns under specific conditions. These systems are still being tested and refined, so things may change before her final release.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44182194/2bc6de85722d6d73206e24400879f993b80dfb55.jpg"]

We can’t wait for you to try her out and see what strategies you come up with! We’ll share more updates on her development as things progress, so stay tuned!

notes.title: FULL RELEASE!! Backpack Battles Patch 1.0 is Here
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 🎉Backpack Battles is coming out of early access today!! 

[previewyoutube="1H0NcstTlKo;full"][/previewyoutube]

🌟 Mage & Adventurer are here! ✨


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44182194/af656c439111c2787905fca2c7eb005cab1ea4f0.png"]



[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2427700/Backpack_Battles/"][/dynamiclink]

You can play them right now! But before that, let's take a look back at the history of Backpack Battles...


How it started...


I can’t believe it’s finally time to write this post.

It really has been a crazy ride from the very first demo until here.

I know some of you have been with us from the very start, back when there were like two recipes in the game.



We had a 9-month-long phase where we worked on the demo, adding content every week and just checking out how y’all reacted to it, and what it did to the game.



This is an unconventional way of making games.

Almost everything in Backpack Battles was developed entirely in the open, most of the time there was less than a week between us having an idea and actually adding it to the game.



You know, we did plan to do this as a small side project - it becoming a years long project instead of a few months long is entirely because of your continued interest in this game.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44182194/61cdb276bc2084615a63cab564e07797311965bd.png"]


...and what it became


Most of the features we now can’t imagine the game without were the results of coming up with a crazy idea, putting it in, seeing how you guys react, often doing a poll, and then reevaluating where to go from here.



These are just some things we only came up with along the way:

Moving bags, subclasses, unique treasures, class badges, alternative loadouts, the build history, the item library, skills, lobbies and so many more. And there are many more things we could and would like to add.



We went from a game where the lategame could only be Bloodthorne or Lightsabers (because those were the only lategame weapons in the game at the time), to a game where I still have things happen in my runs that I have never had before. 



It really wasn’t inevitable to have all those things. But I’m so glad we did not end at 50 items and 2 classes. We added classes #3 and #4 (Berserker and Pyromancer) with the start of the early access.



Now you can finally play classes #5 and #6 (Mage and Adventurer). We added 161 items during the demo phase, 183 during the early access, and another 95 now.

In total, there are now 439 items in the game. That’s a lot of stuff, it really became more than we ever imagined it would be. But of course, there are tons of things we want to add in the future.



We hope you enjoy the Mage and the Adventurer, and all the other small things we put in Backpack Battles for your amusement.


Have fun and thank you!Thanks for staying with us, or for checking us out. For recommending our game or for streaming it. For leaving a nice review, or reporting bugs. And just for enjoying the game. Without you, the game would have been very different.


We also want to thank our partners at IndieArk, who have supported us since the early demo days and brought this game to so many players all around the world. Also, our thanks go out to our playtesters - we wouldn’t have been able to do this without you.



I’m sure you will hear from us soon, with the usual fixes and adjustments.



- Doro and Mario ❤

notes.title: 🎒 Backpack Battles 1.0 is Coming June 13th!! 🎒
notes.content:
Hi everyone - Big news today!

We have been working away behind the scenes and can’t wait to show you what we have been doing:

Here’s the trailer!

[previewyoutube=4506C29cYO4;full][/previewyoutube]

Backpack Battles will finally hit version 1.0 on June 13th, with 2 whole new characters as well as items for the 4 existing classes.

We will leave some surprises open for when you can actually play it, but here are some details:
The two new classes are the Mage and the Adventurer.

The Mage is a bit more complex than the previous classes, with a focus on interesting patterns and buff management.

If you feel like even more puzzling you can choose the Puzzlebox, to place tetrimino-shaped bags. They have a ton of cool Mage-y stuff like wands, spell scrolls, spell books etc, but you best discover them for yourself ;)
The Adventurer is themed around variety and variance. Her main loadout, the Bag of Giving, works a bit like a combination of Rainbow Badge and Present: It lets you access other classes’ items and generate them randomly. It’s pretty wild, and we hope you will love it as much as we do!

There is of course a more tame alternative with her other loadout, which focuses more on tying neutral items together with Twine.

They both will have a full set of items from the start with 5 subclasses, class-specific skills, and a nice set of class items.

There will also be a lot of quality-of-life improvements and polish, but you will see those for yourself soon!


And there is another thing to celebrate: We have hit 1,000,000 sold copies of Backpack Battles. It’s still so hard to comprehend so many of you are playing our game, thanks y’all! ❤

- Dorothea & Mario

notes.title: A Year Full of Backpacks!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We hope you had wonderful holidays so far!

With 2024 coming to an end, it's time for a quick look back and a glimpse into the future of Backpack Battles.

For the development team (meaning Doro and Mario), this year was without a doubt one of the most exciting and wild ones ever.

We entered Early Access in early March and it was without exaggeration an overwhelming once-in-a-lifetime success. Collectively, all Backpack Battles players have a total of 30 million hours (or around 3500 years), which is mindboggling.

Thank you so much, everybody!

Since then, we did everything in our power to make this game as good as it can be.

We added many features, many of which were planned and part of the roadmap - and many of which came up over the last nine months.

So here are some highlights of things we added during the year:


 We had the honor to work with the devs of other indie games we know and love on crossover content, such as Balatro, Claws & Chaos, Magicraft, and Wildfrost!
 We added class badges, so accessing the items of multiple classes at once became possible
 We added loadouts, enabling more playstyles for each class as well as the option to start with a random selection of items
 We added a history where you can see your previous runs and do more fights with them!
 We added skills to make runs more varied and dynamic
 And just now, we added lobbies so you can play with your friends and Custom rules (both for lobbies and unranked games) for whacky fun runs.
 …And of course there also were the Rainbow Goobert and Ranger plushies :)

With the 0.9 update and during Early Access, we added a total of 173 different items! (15 of them being Treasure uniques) - 90 of them coming with the 28 major updates during the EA.

…Towards the launch

Originally, we planned to leave early access within 3-6 months. Looking back - well, we didn't.
As it typically goes, cool ideas pop up during development. And after checking back with you guys on Discord, we decided that taking our time and not closing ourselves off to cool stuff is the better way. This allowed us to implement features like the History, Skills, and Loadout options that we would not want to miss from the game anymore.

One thing you can be sure of is that we are going to fully release in 2025 though! (Stay tuned for an actual announcement)
We have been working on both the Mage and the Adventurer in the background the whole time, and lot of progress has been made.

There is also one thing from the original roadmap that is still untouched: At the start of 2025, we plan to check back with y’all to find out what you want from a ranking system as well as some improvements we have in the back of our heads.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44182194/2d7145c40b2f3d636e0d8f9a6c36c03d7eac3861.jpg

So, everybody…

Thanks again for everything - for recommending Backpack Battles to friends and streamers or streaming it yourself, for leaving reviews, reporting bugs, making our plushies a reality, and simply enjoying the game! ❤ 

We wish you a Happy New Year 2025! 

We are now taking a short break and will be back with a very experimental balancing update on January 3rd. 😉

Besides new items, the main focus is on the new modes: Unranked with custom rules and lobbies!

Behind this, there are currently two things: 

[olist]
 Custom unranked games that allow you to queue against a ranking bracket of your choosing and select custom rules.

 The option to create or join lobbies.
[/olist]
Of course, this is also a nice place where more custom modes could find their home in the future.

What Lobbies Are

Lobbies are designed as a mode to play with a friend or many friends at a time!

You open a lobby by selecting “Host lobby” which will generate a 6-letter lobby code.

Your friends can then join by pressing “Join Lobby” and entering that code. 

All players will play at the same time, with a timer (configurable at the start) ending the shop phase. You will then be matched against one of the other lobby members. Your goal is to win as many rounds out of 18 as possible.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44182194/a45d6dde9ea6a67d60103c012990048500afb484.jpg

What Lobbies Are Not

Lobbies are not planned to become a public mode where anybody can join, this also means it will not be ranked.


The Future

Currently, there are 3 types of custom rules that can be enabled for unranked games - there are lots of opportunities to expand on that. We would love to hear your ideas for interesting custom rules as well.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44182194/3f616e5af96c2a86ac79c110717c39142154b7cc.jpg

A Look Behind The Scenes
We have been working on the lobbies behind the scenes for about a year now and for us, finally being able to show them is a huge milestone towards the game's full release.
When we started developing Backpack Battles, it was planned to become a tiny experimental side project.

Since then, the game’s popularity exploded, and even though we decided to keep developing as a two-person team, we were able to commit to the project full-time.

We never considered adding a synchronous mode to this asynchronous game, but with the decision to make it our main project, we had the resources to consider the massive undertaking of adding a synchronous mode. 

We are so hyped to finally get this feature out to you, and hope you have fun playing with a buddy or two! :)

There is also a Ranger skin based on Yuki, and just as in Wildfrost, her snowball grows over time! And of course, the other classes get a skin as well, check out Doom Cap Reaper, Shaman Beserker and Dark Pyromancer!

We also have a bundle available, where you can purchase both games with an additional 10% discount!
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/46297

New Items!

But wait, there is more. We are adding 10 more skills, so the game now features 30 skills in total. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44182194/b1f16ba157de88216b407439075421faab27577c.jpg

Only one of the new skills is class-specific - Heart of the Cards requires you to have a Deck of Cards. This is for testing the "Requires" keyword.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44182194/c016219a443b8c9802e18fc7b39a7f80a4713359.png

The new skills Just Stats and More Stats will be available in the same slot every run, and offer an alternative to rolling away the skills in case none of them fit your current build.
Of course, picking a fitting skill should still be the better option. 

The Wonky Snowman is a new shop item that breaks up into two Snowballs. Snowball is the new crafting ingredient for Ice items instead of the Spell Scroll: Frostbolt, which makes them accessible earlier and for all classes. This will of course come with adjustments to the Cryomancer subclass.

We reworked the Ripsaw Blade with a completely new mechanic: It removes temporary damage from opponent weapons. It also got its first crafting successor, the Katana!

The other new items are the Amulet of Darkness, a new variant of the Unidentified Amulet, and two recipes: You can now craft Stone Shoes and the Shepherd's Crook.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44182194/7c1c536dc159401b215e74e818fd98d8bfcd6548.png

We gave item types an overhaul: Elemental types like Ice, Holy, etc. are now represented as icons.

We also added icons for different types of damage, you can find them on weapons and other damage-dealing items. The current damage types are Melee, Ranged, and Effect damage - with Effect damage collecting more indirect damage sources. We added several items to buff or counter Effect damage in this update. 

We also revised all item texts and made some changes to improve tooltip readability! Please give yourself a moment to get used to the new tooltips.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44182194/9bc3e3b7427fd0f2a53ac0ef6545e68308631b9e.jpg

Build History

The big quality-of-life feature for this patch is the Build History. 

It keeps the full progression of your builds throughout your runs. And as a little bonus, you can start additional fights to find out how the build would have performed against different opponents.

This also means that you can send your round 18 backpack out to fight as often as you want, which was a commonly requested feature!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44182194/0d9f552bd304e8be72ee523463fdf6ec00979b19.jpg

And there's more! You can now press Alt while hovering over an item to show all the recipes it can build into! This was requested a bunch of times, and we found a way to display the recipes nicely. As always, we do our best to make features as useful as possible - the tooltips also show which items you already own and which ones can be bought from the current shop.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44182194/ea0bdc0bfcf8e7877165c7b497ab87ee75979021.jpg

More Languages

With this update, the game now supports Latin American Spanish, French, Russian, and Brazilian Portuguese! You can change the language in the options if Steam doesn't apply it automatically.
We hope this makes the game accessible to more players around the world! 

Magicraft Crossover

In case you missed it, we just added Pop and Cthulhu from Magicraft as Unique items last week! They just had their 1.0 release - and don't forget you can get it with a discount if you already own Backpack Battles:

notes.title: Skill Update Hits Beta Branch!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

The upcoming update is both the biggest and most experimental yet!

In rounds 4 and 10 you will be able to pick 1 out of 3 Skills. 

Skills are a special kind of item that mixes up the gameplay and opens up now kinds of builds.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44182194/58fa74b9bbf72b5206e0357dff2533a7e2f4e29c.jpg

Here are two examples. It’s Slime Time can drop in round 4 and gives you access to Gooblings, a new item, and is the basis for a Goobert-based strategy:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44182194/5aaea7776911a80631742283e6356989520f2051.jpg

Mana Mastery is a Skill that can be found in both round 4 and round 10. It is a Mana source and makes Mana Orbs a more effective payoff.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44182194/19ce6a49e2b3635980a02d199ca7e6559b0d5cec.jpg

Currently, there is a total of 20 skills, some can only be found in round 4, some only in round 10 and some of them are in both pools (you can check this in the item info panel). Each class has 2 class-specific skills.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44182194/b4cb1bb754f72a9f654f4bb7cb56c850a2073ea0.png


This is a very experimental feature that we have great hopes for. After a sufficiently long testing period, we plan to start a poll on our Discord to see if you like it as much as we do, and plan our following steps accordingly.

Joining the Beta

You can play it by joining the public beta branch. If you have never participated before, you can instructions on how to join on our Discord server. It is planned to come to the main branch on 20th September. Until then, have fun testing and do not forget: The beta branch is for finding issues, bugs are to be expected - please report them in our Discord or the steam community so they can be addressed.

Future Updates

While this is the last major mechanic we plan to integrate in the game, we are still working on the private lobbies (play with friends) as well as different quality-of-life features. We will also add many more items, including a second set of skills! With the 1.0 release, we will add two more classes and Steam achievements.

 A weapon that uses stamina to generate Empower
 Items that are Magic, Holy, Dark and Vampiric all at the same time
 The first craftable bag
 A way to damage ranged opponents with Spikes
 And more!

That being said, it is to be expected that some of these new items will require balance adjustments in the future or push existing builds over the edge, so expect balance adjustments in the following weeks until we are happy with the state!

notes.title: Hotfixes & Help with Technical Issues
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Backpack Battles has been out for 4 days now! We've been busy fixing bugs and have already pushed some hotfix patches. You can view the recent patch notes ingame by clicking the version number on the bottom right. We also post them on our Discord server.

We wanted to address some common technical issues and frequently asked questions.

Steam Deck Issues
For some reason we don't know, Steam doesn't launch the correct build on Steam Deck, and the game instantly crashes when you try to start it up. The workaround to get it to launch is by enabling and disabling Compatibility.

In your library click on Backpack Battles, click the cog button on the right, open Properties, Compatibility, check "Force the use of a specific Steam Play compatibility tool", uncheck again, close properties. It should start normally from that point onward.

Controller support
The game has controller support, and with the 0.9.0f patch, you can reconfigure gamepad inputs in the options. It should display icons that match the controller you're using. Please give feedback, and let us know if you encounter issues, so we can add "Full controller support" to the store page.

Game does not start
This seems to be an issue with missing dependencies on some systems that we are trying to figure out. In many cases, verifying the game files fixes it. We also checked some settings in the backend to hopefully fix this issue. 

Family Sharing does not work
We do not know what causes this, and we have contacted Steam support several days ago but haven't got a response yet.

Update: Steam support fixed it!

We're doing our best to make the game accessible to all of you, thank you for helping us with bug reports etc.! We're also planning a balance patch soon.

Thanks for playing, have fun!

notes.title: Backpack Battles is in EARLY ACCESS NOW! 🎒⚔
notes.content:
Pack Your Backpacks!
Hi everyone,

The time has finally come. Backpack Battles is available on Steam! We are so happy you can finally play what we have been working on all this time, now grab your bag and play!

You can now choose between four classes: Ranger, Reaper, Pyromancer, and Berserker!
All classes have five subclasses to choose from in the 8th round. There are tons of new content to explore!

[previewyoutube=SJAbeIH1f_4;full][/previewyoutube]

Early Access Plans
Our work is not done here. There are plenty of features we want to add during Early Access. And here is our roadmap!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44182194/1b047bfa5f20d1469fb3b11cf39e04c68c4f368c.png

The points are roughly ordered, and multiple things will probably progress in parallel. But the first thing will be to work on the new classes - it is to be expected that there are bugs to fix and balancing to address.

Lobbies are a feature that was frequently requested in the past. We have made progress behind the scenes and built a successful proof of concept, but it is a large feature and we don’t know how much time it will take.

Another feature we planned for so long is to give you guys more statistics about every item in the item library. We feel like it could be really cool to see how often you bought an item, how far you came with it, and for example, what your highest rank win was with that item. We also have been writing flavor texts that we plan to display there.

The combat log has been a favorite since we added it, and we plan to work on it more until release. There are a few features that would be helpful, like a search function and a way to see precisely when an item activates.

We also plan to touch the ranking system. We can’t say too much yet, but it is very well possible that it will be seasonal. With the release, the rankings from the demo were already reset, and it is very possible that with large changes or seasons, there will be more resets.

The unique item pool has grown substantially since we introduced it, often with seasonal items. We want to produce many additional Uniques, and we have lots of ideas already!

And of course, we will be working on new outfits for the characters. Currently, the new classes have two outfits and two chibi-style outfits.

Full Release
The features that define the end of Early access and the start of full release are the 5th character and Steam achievements. We plan to add the “Adventurer”, a class that stands over typical class restrictions and starts each round with random items, similar to the “Present” unique. We received many requests to give the present a larger role, and we think this is the coolest way. This also means that according to plan, the adventurer would not have any (or very few) class-specific items. Also, keep in mind that this is in the concept phase, so it’s subject to change.

Patches & Demo
Also, we will shift our patch schedule. We are very proud of our streak of 39 consecutive content patches on Sundays, but for the Early Access, we will switch to less regular larger patches. This will give us time to work on the big features we have planned. 

About the demo: It will remain available both on Steam and itch.io! If you’re not sure whether you want to buy the full game, definitely check the demo out!

Hot Bundles

We are excited to offer you two awesome bundles with a 10% discount! 
Both Slay the Spire and Brotato are incredible games you should not miss out on!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/39016

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/39017

Thank You

It is important to us to thank you all. This game has far surpassed our wildest expectations already. As game developers, all we want is for people to enjoy our game. Having the game resonate with so many of you is a dream come true. We will continue to give our best and make Backpack Battles the best game we can.

We want to give a shoutout to IndieArk who supported us a lot and even organized a localization into Traditional Chinese for release. 

If you like the game, the best way to support us is by writing a review on Steam. Reviews are extremely important for visibility on the store and for this game to succeed! We would appreciate it very much.

We’re looking forward to reading your opinions and discussing the game’s features on our Discord server. You can also share item ideas and your favorite builds there!

Have fun! 🤍

notes.title: Backpack Battles is Coming to Early Access March 8, 2024!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We have a big surprise for you all! 

[previewyoutube=qqhlUfR3B2Q;full][TRAILER][/previewyoutube]

We have decided to go into Early Access in early March of this year!

This means you will have access to all classes earlier than previously announced.
We have been asked many times if we can launch earlier, and this way we can 🥳

From the start of Early Access, BOTH the Berserker and the Pyromancer will be fully playable. Each of them comes with a full set of 5 subclasses and already a total of 25 to 30 class-specific items.

The goal of the EA phase will be to polish and balance the new classes. We are aiming for a pretty short duration of a few months until the full release. And of course, we’ll be adding more items and general quality-of-life features during EA - and who knows what else!

The Berserker
The Berserker is rough, tough, and angry. Her core mechanic is Battle Rage, which gives her increased attack speed and damage resistance when in danger. Many Berserker-specific items interact with Battle Rage and do something special when it activates!
The Berserker starts with a Forging Hammer, which she can use to upgrade items.

The Pyromancer
Some people love to see the world burn. Literally. Pyromancers find arson awesome!
The Pyromancer can both buy and generate 1-gold Flames, that generate Heat on their own. Flames can be used to set items on fire or infuse them with Heat.
Some of her signature items can use Heat as a resource for massive effects, such as reincarnation!


So, here are some questions we think you might have and our answers:

Will you still update the demo in parallel?

The demo will stay up, but it will no longer get content updates. Instead, the Early Access version will be updated. This way, the Early Access-exclusive content does not lead to unfairness for the demo players.

Will demo players be matched against EA players?

No, the player pools will be separated.

Will my progress from the demo transfer?

Ranking will probably reset towards Early Access and possibly during Early Access as well.
We will, however, do our best to transfer all unlocks (trophies, skins, etc)

notes.title: A Year Full of Backpacks
notes.content:
It was a wild year. Without any exaggeration, a life-changing one for us.
Some of you don't know this, but the core team is just us two: Doro and Mario. We live together, code together and design together.

Before February, there was no “Backpack Battles”, not even the idea to make something like that.
And out of nowhere, you appeared and played our game.
We somehow went from an idea, that we were unsure about if it would even work - to what has been the most played demo on Steam for months.

You often ask us how much of this was planned,
so yeah... the whole game is a big experiment.
This is not the type of game that can be planned too much, and we decided early to embrace the unknowable rather than try to control it. The best ideas only ever come up when the game is actively being played - without this approach, we would have never discovered some (now) core features such as recipes, or the ability to lift bags after they were first placed.

We are also still on a streak, and managed to patch some new content into the game every Sunday since we released the demo on May 30, 2023!

So, where is this all gonna lead us?
Here is what we know:
In parallel with the weekly content, we have been working on the new classes and subclasses behind the scenes. When we launch, we will do that with 2 more classes, the Pyromancer and the Berserker, and a total of 20 subclasses (5 per class). This has been a hefty chunk of content to prepare, but we are very happy with it and well on schedule! (surprisingly)
We can’t give an exact number of items yet, but it will be a substantial increase from the current state 😀

There is also some more great news regarding the launch on the horizon that we can’t talk about just yet. Stay tuned for more announcements :)

So, thanks everybody for playing our game! 💛
I hope you have fun, we promise we will do everything we can to make it the best game possible.

And Happy New Year!
